Game Overview

In Sun Wukong, the core idea is straightforward: step into the mythical world of Sun Wukong, an exhilarating retro-style arcade adventure. Maneuver the legendary creature through platform-filled levels, conquering foes and discovering hidden secrets. With intuitive controls and a nostalgic vibe, this game offers a delightful escape into Chinese folklore, perfect for gamers of all ages.
